AuPM / g.desc: Augmented plus-minus -- an estimate of RAPM using a player's on/off data and his teammates on/off data -- converted to a per game value based on minutes per game played

Load.desc: An estimate of the number of a player a player is 'directly involved' in on offense every 100 possessions.

Box Creation.desc: An estimate of shots created for teammates per 100 possessions.

Passer Rating.desc: An estimate of a player’s passing ability on (approximately) a 1-10 scale

cTOV%.desc: creation-adjusted turnover rate, or turnovers committed as a percentage of offensive load

ScoreVal.desc: Scoring value, an estimate of a player’s points per 100 impact from scoring only.

PlayVal.desc: Playmaking value, an estimate of a player’s points per 100 impact from playmaking only.

rOS%.desc: Overall Scoring percentage relative to the league -- this is true shooting, with "scoring" turnovers and self-rebounded misses included.

Good:Bad Pass.desc: Ratio of active beneficial passes to bad pass turnovers. 3.7 is a 3.7:1 ratio.

Handle TOV%.desc: Percentage of turnovers coming from ball-handling (lost ball fumble) turnovers

Non-Pass TOV%.desc: Percentage of turnovers coming from all non-pass turnovers (charges, offensive fouls, travels, etc.)

Drives / 36.desc: Drives per 36 minutes per optical tracking

FTA : Rim FGA.desc: Percentage of overall true shot attempts (FGA+FTA) that are at the rim or from free throws

Midrange FGA.desc: Short and long midrange shots per 75 possessions

Corner 3 Share.desc: Percentage of a player’s 3-point attempts that come from corner 3s

Def FGA Diff%.desc: 2-year expected difference on shots as the nearest defender inside 6-feet of the hoop

Forced TOV.desc: Forced Turnovers (steals + charges drawn + offensive fouls drawn) per 75

rRim2FT.desc: Rim2FT against the league's that season: opponents' rim points and free throws per 100 possessions with him on the floor, minus the league's (runouts left out)

Rim2FT.desc: Opponents' points on shots under 5 ft, with their free throws, per 100 possessions with him on the floor (runouts left out)

Team Net.desc: A bayesian weighted combination of the regular season and playoff team performance, based on opponent quality

Team Off.desc: A bayesian weighted combination of the regular season and playoff team performance, based on opponent quality

Team Def.desc: A bayesian weighted combination of the regular season and playoff team performance, based on opponent quality

Mates Spacing.desc: An estimate of teammate outside shooting quality
